extraction.notes: No explicitly dated 2027 summer schedule or registration opening was found. The dates-and-rates listing does not expose its session table in readable text; individual course pages were available through official search results but returned empty text when opened. Cards cover the North Carolina youth offerings found. Undated tuition amounts are recorded in review notes rather than assigned a summer year. Florida, California and international satellite offerings are not covered by these Asheville-area cards.
